name: hermes-commander
description: Local computer control for ChatGPT Desktop through Hermes Node.

interface.longDescription: Hermes Commander gives ChatGPT Desktop a multi-device control plane backed by Hermes Nodes for files, terminals, processes, screenshots, Windows UI Automation, semantic element control, managed Chrome and private Tailscale-connected computers or Android/Termux nodes that you own and control.
capabilities: Inspect and operate semantic UI elements
Select and control multiple private Hermes Nodes
